title: Integrative transcriptomic and machine learning framework reveals candidate genes and potential mechanisms of aflatoxin B1 exposure in breast cancer.
authors: Wang, Wenjing; Liu, Mengting; Li, Xiang
one_liner_zh: 该研究用机器学习整合转录组多组学分析AFB1暴露与乳腺癌的候选基因，虽涉及转录因子调控映射，但核心是疾病标志物与机制推断，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Aflatoxin B1 (AFB1), a known mycotoxin and environmental hazard, has been linked to breast cancer, yet the exact biological pathways remain poorly characterized. We performed a comprehensive multi-omics assessment to investigate how AFB1 may influence breast tumor biology. This encompassed transcriptomic analysis, co-expression network modeling (WGCNA), immune landscape profiling, transcription factor regulatory mapping, and spatial plus single-cell transcriptomics. Predictive biomarkers were determined through a machine learning pipeline. Twenty-two genes were identified at the intersection of AFB1-predicted targets and disease-associated expression modules. A refined panel of seven biomarkers (EGFR, MIF, MET, PPARG, MME, NQO2, NR3C2) was established through model optimization. A composite classifier using glmBoost and StepGLM achieved high discriminative accuracy (area under the curve = 0.996). SHAP interpretability indicated PPARG may act protectively, while MIF showed risk-promoting characteristics. Expression heterogeneity was observed across cell populations and spatial regions. Our integrated analytical framework offers new insights into the oncogenic potential of AFB1 in breast cancer. The identified gene set may serve as both mechanistic mediators and diagnostic markers, underscoring the value of multi-omics and machine learning approaches in environmental carcinogenesis research.
abstract_zh: 黄曲霉毒素B1（AFB1）是一种已知的真菌毒素和环境危害物，与乳腺癌相关，但其确切的生物学通路仍缺乏充分表征。我们进行了全面的多组学评估，以探究AFB1可能如何影响乳腺肿瘤生物学。这包括转录组分析、共表达网络建模（WGCNA）、免疫景观谱分析、转录因子调控图谱绘制，以及空间和单细胞转录组学。通过机器学习流程确定了预测性生物标志物。在AFB1预测靶标与疾病相关表达模块的交集中，鉴定出22个基因。通过模型优化，建立了一个由七种生物标志物（EGFR、MIF、MET、PPARG、MME、NQO2、NR3C2）组成的精炼组合。使用glmBoost和StepGLM的复合分类器实现了高判别准确性（曲线下面积 = 0.996）。SHAP可解释性表明PPARG可能起保护作用，而MIF显示出风险促进特征。在不同细胞群体和空间区域中观察到表达异质性。我们的整合分析框架为AFB1在乳腺癌中的致癌潜力提供了新见解。所鉴定的基因集可能既作为机制介导因子，又作为诊断标志物，凸显了多组学和机器学习方法在环境致癌研究中的价值。
